subject: [RFC PATCH v2 02/18] splice: don't steal page cache folios

reviews.author: David Hildenbrand (Arm)
reviews.summary: Raised concerns about the impact of removing the steal functionality and suggested providing more context on why it's no longer needed. Also asked for information on potential users that might be affected by this change.

reviews.author: Kiryl Shutsemau (Meta)
reviews.summary: Provided additional context on the history of the steal functionality and its current usage. Asked for input from other reviewers on potential users that might be affected by this change.

2026-11-04.patch_summary: This RFC patch proposes to remove the ability for splice operations to 'steal' page cache folios, which are then reused without being freed. The patch aims to prevent potential issues such as fs corruption and data loss when a server splices into /dev/fuse with SPLICE_F_MOVE. Instead of stealing, both fuse and virtio_console's splice_write() will copy the page cache folios.
